fusions.name: Rehearsed Bolt
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 7 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets. For 2 seconds after using it, you move 15% faster. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Garbled Syllable
fusions.desc: Speaks a garbled word that deals 26 arcane damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and ignores resistances. For 4 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Encore Reading
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Corrected Proof
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
